Add a DNS TXT record to prove you own example.test.

DNS RECORD TO ADD

TYPE

TXT

NAME

_cyphward

VALUE

cyphward-verification=local-review-token

Enter only _cyphward as the Name/Host — your DNS panel (Cloudflare, Namecheap, GoDaddy) adds .example.test itself, so the record ends up at _cyphward.example.test. It can take a few minutes to appear. Once it's saved, click Verify domain.
